prompt:
Bug: the setup wizard says a user's own username and email are taken.

A user whose account already exists (for example one created on their first OIDC login) goes through the setup wizard and re-submits their own name and email. The wizard checks them with GET /api/validators/user/name?name=... and GET /api/validators/user/email?email=..., which answer {"valid": false}, because a user with that name or email exists: the user themself.

Expected: when the request is signed in, the signed-in user's own username and own email are valid (200, "valid": true). A username or email that belongs to any other user, in the same group or in another group, is still invalid ("valid": false). The endpoints keep working without signing in, and then behave as today: an existing username or email is invalid, an unused one is valid. Matching stays case-insensitive.

Tests: `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/integration_tests/test_validators.py` for quick loops; the whole backend suite is `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests` (about 8 minutes).
title: fix: accept the signed-in user's own username and email in validators (#8811)
